description: Source file implementing functions for querying and managing thread-local GL and EGL state, including thread management, mutex handling, and debugger wait logic.

classes.name: Thread
classes.description: Represents a thread in the EGL context management.

classes.name: Context
classes.description: Represents an OpenGL or EGL context.

methods.name: AllocateCurrentThread
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a new Thread object for the current thread.

methods.name: AllocateDebug
methods.description: Creates a Debug object if it does not already exist.

methods.name: AllocateMutex
methods.description: Creates a global mutex for thread synchronization.

methods.name: GetGlobalMutex
methods.description: Returns a reference to the global mutex.

methods.name: GetCurrentThread
methods.description: Retrieves or creates the Thread object for the current thread.

methods.name: SetContextCurrent
methods.description: Sets the current context for a thread, managing global state accordingly.

methods.name: DeallocateCurrentThread
methods.description: Deletes the Thread object for the current thread.

methods.name: InitializeProcess
methods.description: Initializes thread-local storage, debug, and mutex for process startup.

methods.name: TerminateProcess
methods.description: Cleans up thread-local storage, debug, and mutex during process shutdown.

methods.name: WaitForDebugger
methods.description: Pauses execution until a debugger is attached, if enabled.
